values.label: Trainer Level demo default
values.note: Trainer Level is exposed because Rocket scaling may depend on it. Level 50 is a demo default only.

values.label: Pokemon GO battle turn length
values.note: Used for Trainer Battle move duration displays from PvPoke turn counts.

values.label: Rocket pause after player Charged Attack
values.note: NPC battles are documented as pausing for 2 seconds, or 4 turns, after either side uses a Charged Attack.

values.label: Rocket pause after player switch
values.note: NPC battles are documented as pausing for 2 seconds, or 4 turns, after a switch-in except the initial send-in.

values.label: Charged Attack wall-clock overhead
values.note: Approximate real animation duration from tap through damage and normal play resuming. This is not used as the battle-turn timeline scale.

values.label: Charged Attack battle-turn registration
values.note: Experimental simulator default. Charged Attacks register as a 0.5-turn span on the battle-turn timeline, while real animation takes longer.

values.label: Trainer Battle damage multiplier
values.note: Trainer Battles apply a 30% attack damage boost.

values.label: Rocket packet-capture CP multiplier
values.note: Pokebattler Rocket CP research reports this multiplier from packet-capture examples and applies it to the Rocket difficulty multiplier table.

values.label: Rocket attack stat multiplier
values.note: Rocket Shadow Pokemon attack uses 2 * (base attack + Rocket attack IV) * rCPM * rank multiplier.

values.label: Rocket defense stat multiplier
values.note: Rocket Shadow Pokemon defense uses 0.8 * (base defense + 15) * rCPM * rank multiplier.

values.label: Rocket stamina stat multiplier
values.note: Rocket Shadow Pokemon stamina uses 1.1 * (base stamina + 9) * rCPM * rank multiplier, with battle HP rounded down.

values.label: Rocket Grunt rank multiplier
values.note: Rocket CP research and Bulbapedia list Grunts, Jessie, and James at rank multiplier 1.

values.label: Rocket Leader rank multiplier
values.note: Rocket CP research and Bulbapedia list Team GO Rocket Leaders at rank multiplier 1.05.

values.label: Giovanni rank multiplier
values.note: Rocket CP research and Bulbapedia list Giovanni at rank multiplier 1.15.

values.label: Rocket opponent Charged Attack interval
values.note: Fallback cadence used only when a Rocket opponent has no sourced charged move. Sourced Rocket moves now use fast-move energy gain and charged-move costs.

values.label: Rocket opponent Charged Attack damage
values.note: Fallback damage when a Rocket charged move is unavailable. Sourced Rocket charged moves use the Trainer Battle damage formula.

values.label: Player shields
values.note: Trainer Battles use two player Protect Shields; the simulator currently shields the first two opponent Charged Attacks.

values.label: Rocket Grunt shields
values.note: Team GO Rocket Grunts are documented as never using Protect Shields.

values.label: Rocket Leader shields
values.note: Team GO Rocket Leaders are documented as always shielding the player's first two Charged Attacks.

values.label: Giovanni shields
values.note: Giovanni is documented as always shielding the player's first two Charged Attacks.

values.label: Rocket opponent proxy HP slot 1
values.note: Fallback proxy HP only when a Rocket species is missing from normalized PvPoke data; sourced Rocket stats are used when species data exists.

values.label: Rocket opponent proxy HP slot 2
values.note: Fallback proxy HP only when a Rocket species is missing from normalized PvPoke data; sourced Rocket stats are used when species data exists.

values.label: Rocket opponent proxy HP slot 3
values.note: Fallback proxy HP only when a Rocket species is missing from normalized PvPoke data; sourced Rocket stats are used when species data exists.

values.label: Rocket Grunt incoming damage proxy
values.note: Temporary incoming damage proxy. It is not sourced and should only be used for experimental comparisons.

values.label: Rocket Leader incoming damage proxy
values.note: Temporary incoming damage proxy. It is not sourced and should only be used for experimental comparisons.

values.label: Giovanni incoming damage proxy
values.note: Temporary incoming damage proxy. It is not sourced and should only be used for experimental comparisons.
